Generate a Jaccard-Overlap Network of GO Terms with Leiden Clustering

Source: R/network_utils.R
generate_overlap_network.Rd

Constructs an undirected, weighted network where nodes are enriched GO terms and edge weights are Jaccard overlap coefficients between their DE gene sets. Edges below overlap_threshold are removed. Leiden community detection is applied to identify clusters of functionally related terms, and each cluster gets candidate theme labels. CSV summaries of node-level and cluster-level statistics are exported when outdir is set.

Usage

generate_overlap_network(
  results_set,
  collection,
  de_genes,
  collection_name = "network",
  overlap_threshold = 0.1,
  leiden_resolution = 1,
  objective_function = c("modularity", "CPM"),
  seed = 1234,
  outdir = NULL,
  file_stem = NULL,
  ident1 = NULL,
  ident2 = NULL,
  zscore_threshold = 1,
  theme_n_words = 3,
  theme_ancestor_min_share = 0.15,
  theme_ancestor_max_size = 1000,
  theme_max_ancestors = 2
)

Arguments

results_set

Data frame with row names equal to GO term descriptions and at least the column avg_log2FC (mean fold-change across member genes), as returned by build_network_inputs. If it also has zscore, median_log2FC, n_up, and n_down columns, node direction is called from the z-score (see zscore_threshold); otherwise from the sign of avg_log2FC.

collection

Named list of character vectors. Each element is a set of gene symbols belonging to one GO term. Names must match rownames(results_set).

de_genes

Character vector of all differentially expressed gene symbols. Gene sets in collection are intersected with this vector before computing overlaps.

collection_name

Character label used in plot titles and console output. Typically formatted as "<comparison>_<celltype>" (e.g., "CD206_Car_vs_Bleo_Fibroblast_1").

overlap_threshold

Numeric [0, 1]. Jaccard coefficient below which edges are set to zero. Default 0.1.

leiden_resolution

Numeric. Resolution for Leiden clustering. With the default modularity objective, values around 1 are standard; higher values give more, smaller clusters. Use plot_leiden_sweep to choose a value. Default 1.

objective_function

Character. Leiden objective passed to igraph::cluster_leiden: "modularity" (default; resolution is comparable across networks) or "CPM" (constant Potts model; resolution acts as an edge-density cutoff and needs much smaller values, e.g. 0.03).

seed

Integer seed for Leiden clustering and the plot layout, so results are reproducible. It does not change the random state of your session. NULL disables seeding. Default 1234.

outdir

Character path to the output directory. If NULL, no files are written. The directory is created if it does not exist.

file_stem

Character string used as the filename prefix for all exported files. If NULL or empty, collection_name is used. Stored in the result as the default stem for plot_network.

ident1, ident2

Character. The numerator and denominator identities of the comparison, used in plot legends as "Upregulated in <ident1>" and "Upregulated in <ident2>". If NULL (default), they are parsed from collection_name around "_vs_".

zscore_threshold

Numeric. A node is called "up" when its direction z-score is at least this value, "down" when it is at most minus this value, and "mixed" otherwise. Default 1.

theme_n_words

Integer. Number of keywords per cluster in the keywords theme label. Default 3.

theme_ancestor_min_share

Numeric (0, 1]. Minimum share of a cluster's terms an ancestor must cover to be used as a label. Default 0.15.

theme_ancestor_max_size

Integer. GO terms with more descendants than this are considered too generic to be a label (for reference: "cell cycle" has about 800, "response to stress" about 1,300, "cellular process" about 16,000). Default 1000.

theme_max_ancestors

Integer. Maximum number of ancestors in one cluster label. Default 2.

Value

NULL (with a message) if no two terms overlap at overlap_threshold. Otherwise a scoranet_network object: a list with the following elements.

network

An igraph graph object with vertex attributes fc, regulation, size, cluster, color, and shape.

clustering

The communities object returned by igraph::cluster_leiden.

overlap_matrix

Square numeric matrix of pairwise Jaccard coefficients (before thresholding).

go_term_df

Data frame with columns go_term, cluster, degree, regulation ("up", "down", or "mixed"), avg_log2FC (mean), median_log2FC, n_up, n_down, zscore, go_id, and leiden_resolution. The direction columns are NA when results_set has no z-score columns, and go_id is NA when it has no GO IDs.

cluster_stats

Data frame with columns cluster, avg_degree, and n_terms.

leiden_resolution, objective_function, overlap_threshold, seed

The settings used.

term_genes

Named list: for each node (GO term), the DE genes it contains. Used by plot_driver_genes.

cluster_themes

Data frame with one row per Leiden cluster: cluster, n_terms; the shared GO ancestors (ancestor, names joined by " / "; ancestor_id, IDs joined by ";"; ancestor_n_covered, how many of the cluster's terms fall under them; NA if none qualifies); and the other candidate labels keywords, phrase, and hub.

cluster_palette

Character vector of cluster colours (from the 40-colour dittoSeq palette), one per cluster.

layout

Two-column matrix of node coordinates (Fruchterman-Reingold, seeded with seed). Shared by every plot_network type except themes, and kept by recluster_network.

collection_name, ident1, ident2, file_stem

Labels used for plot titles, legends, and file names.

theme_args

The theme label settings, reused by recluster_network.

Details

This function draws no plots. Check the clustering with run_network_diagnostics, change the resolution with recluster_network if needed, then draw figures with plot_network. network_tables returns the tables that are written as CSVs.

Side effects

When outdir is non-NULL, the tables from network_tables are written:

  • <file_stem>_network_summary.csv – node/edge/cluster counts.

  • <file_stem>-cluster-stats.csv – per-cluster average degree.

  • <file_stem>-cluster-membership.csv – every GO term in the network with its Leiden cluster: the columns of go_term_df plus genes, the term's DE genes separated by "/". Sorted by cluster, then by degree.

  • <file_stem>-cluster-themes.csv – one row per cluster with its size and candidate labels (cluster_themes).

No plots are drawn or saved; use plot_network.
